actions.label: The apples and plate are initially on the table; the left hand moves to the first apple.
The left hand grasps the first apple and moves it above the plate.
The left hand releases the apple onto the plate, then moves to the second apple.
The left hand grasps the second apple and moves it above the plate.
The left hand releases the apple onto the plate, then moves to the third apple.
The left hand grasps the third apple and moves it above the plate.
The left hand releases the apple onto the plate; the right hand moves to the fourth apple.
The right hand grasps the apple and moves it above the plate.
The right hand releases the apple onto the plate, then moves to the fifth apple.
The right hand grasps the fifth apple and moves it above the plate.
The right hand releases the apple onto the plate, completing the placement.
